mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, title, content, status, category, email, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM support_tickets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_tickets ( user_id, title, content, status, category, email, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{category}, #{email}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, question, answer FROM faq_items ORDER BY sort_order ASC
